deadline.value: Fall applications for the PhD in geology or geophysics close January 15.
deadline.quote: January 15 for Spring and Fall admission

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to connect with a faculty supervisor at the time of application.
supervisor.quote: Graduate applicants interested in research-based programs are strongly encouraged to connect with a faculty supervisor at the time of application

funding.value: Memorial describes competitive funding packages; the earth sciences page lists a PhD stipend of about $21,800 a year.
funding.quote: Memorial University offers competitive funding packages to academically eligible full-time graduate students, both Canadian and international, in all eligible research programs

entry_route.value: Successful PhD applicants normally hold an MSc, though exceptional BSc students may be considered.
entry_route.quote: Successful applicants to the PhD program will normally have completed an MSc degree, although exceptionally well-qualified BSc students will be considered for direct entry to the PhD program

notes: The department's general-information page gives a PhD stipend of $21,600 a year, which differs from the $21,800 on the program page. That page also gives an old paper-scale TOEFL minimum of 550 with a waiver after two years of English-language study; the university 80 iBT rule is used. Covers both Geology and Geophysics.
name: Earth Sciences (Geology and Geophysics)
